status: independent OFF candidate, not runtime fitted/adopted
axes: Blender X along-bank, Y toward-water, Z up; glTF (x,y,z)=(Blender x,z,-y)
origin: local soil top at patch centre
material: 2 opaque, nonmetallic Principled PBR materials; roughness .88/.91; no images, no AO encoded as RGB, no alpha cards
usage: Candidate only. Place sparingly within bank50 middle-root-lobe; deform/fix actual mesh to heightAt and real side slope, with starts and tips buried. Do not tile entire bank. Preview soil and scale are not exported.
limitations: Root morphology is hand-designed from general fibrous growth, not a species or site scan.
Representative soil face is not the exact runtime bank. No placement/contact/visibility adoption claim.
No micro root hairs: fine terminal roots below about a tenth millimetre are not intended for sustained distant rendering.
